movie.title: BLACKPINK: Light Up the Sky
movie.overview: Record-shattering Korean girl band BLACKPINK tell their story —  and detail the hard fought journey of the dreams and trials behind their meteoric rise.

facts: Did you know 'BLACKPINK: Light Up the Sky' was directed by Caroline Suh? She's the talent behind bringing their incredible story to the screen!
Talk about quick turnarounds! This documentary dropped just under two weeks after BLACKPINK's very first studio album, "The Album," was released. What a busy time for the group!
Critics really appreciated how the film focused on each member! It was described as "an endearing documentary that emphasizes each member's individuality," letting their unique personalities shine.
